player_prompt.intro: Umdlali {player_id} kuQuantum Tic Tac Toe. Isimboli yakho ngu-'{symbol}', futhi izinombolo zakho zokuhamba zihlala ziyi-{parity} (isib., X1, X3 noma O2, O4). Umgomo: Wina ngokwakha umugqa wamamaki amathathu akudala (aqiniswe kusuka kuma-superpositions). Indlela Yokudlala: - Ekuphendukeni ngakunye, beka uphawu olwesabekayo ezikweleni ezimbili ezingenalutho ezihlukene usebenzisa ifomethi '[a,b]'. - Lezi zimpawu zixakanisiwe, futhi zifakwe ilebula njenge-'X1 / X1' noma 'O4 / O4'. - Awukwazi ukubeka izimpawu ezesabekayo esikhaleni esivele siwile (siqinisiwe). Umthetho wokuwa: - Uma isinyathelo sakho sakha umjikelezo emgqeni wokuxakaniswa, siyawa ngokuzenzakalelayo. - Uphawu ngalunye olwesabekayo kumjikelezo luba uphawu olujwayelekile kwesinye sezikhundla zalo ezimbili. - Noma yimaphi amamaki asusayo nawo ayawa. - Ukunqoba: Uma umdlalo uphela lapho bobabili abadlali benamaphuzu amathathu alandelanayo emgqeni olune ngenombolo elifanayo, umdlali uzuza u-'[0,4] - Isibonelo: Uma umdlali ngamunye edlala uhola u-0 futhi udlala endaweni eyodwa ngesikhathi sokuhamba komugqa.
